summary: get_url options for SELinux context, request timeout, temporary download location, and headers not to forward on redirects (e.g. Authorization).
questions: How do I increase the get_url timeout?
Where does get_url store the temp file during download?
How do I avoid leaking Authorization headers on redirects?

answer_card.title: get_url timeout, tmp_dest, redirects
answer_card.answer_md:
- `timeout` (10s)
- `tmp_dest`: temp download path (defaults to `remote_tmp`)
- `unredirected_headers`: header names not resent on redirects (e.g. `Authorization`)
- `seuser`/`serole`/`setype`/`selevel`
